# W52 stock String-key Map fixture

This Wide part was generated by the public ClickHouse local binary
`26.7.1.1315` (official build) using
[`scripts/generate_public_wide_map_string_w52_fixture.sh`](../../../../scripts/generate_public_wide_map_string_w52_fixture.sh).
The source table uses `index_granularity = 2`, `index_granularity_bytes =
10485760`, Wide parts, plain `.mrk2` marks, and LZ4 compression.

The exact schema is `pk UInt64`, `map_u64 Map(String, UInt64)`, and
`map_string Map(String, String)`. Seven sorted rows produce mark row counts
`[2, 2, 2, 1]`. The maps include empty rows, duplicate keys, a String key with
bytes `41 00 42 ff`, and empty and nonempty values. `columns_substreams.txt`
records the stock child stream layout. `SHA256SUMS` covers every file in
`part/`.
